notes: Stories refined to strengthen API contract clarity and integration boundaries without adding new IDs.

change_log.value: Integrate transparency fields into provider search/evaluation responses via find_care_facade and evaluate_care_facade, ensuring explicit API contract propagation and backward compatibility.
Add tests validating correct attribution labeling, dual-pipeline cases, dedup behavior, API contract consistency, and end-to-end facade-to-UI data flow.
Update ChatWindow/MessageBubble rendering to display specialty match explanations including pipeline origin in a user-readable format, preserving attribution semantics from backend contract.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Transparency Schema and Contract
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S1.description: Define response schema exposing matched_classifications, pipeline_origin (regex, vector, or both), and attribution metadata for specialty matching.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S2.title: Implement Dual-Pipeline Attribution Logic
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S2.description: Extend specialty_service to tag each matched classification with its originating pipeline (regex, vector) and handle deduplication while preserving attribution.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S3.title: Expose Specialty Transparency via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S3.description: Integrate transparency fields into provider search/evaluation responses via find_care_facade and evaluate_care_facade, ensuring explicit API contract propagation and backward compatibility.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Transparency
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S4.description: Add tests validating correct attribution labeling, dual-pipeline cases, dedup behavior, API contract consistency, and end-to-end facade-to-UI data flow.

EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S5.title: Render Specialty Match Transparency in Chat UI
EVAL-SPECIALTY-CREDIBILITY-S5.description: Update ChatWindow/MessageBubble rendering to display specialty match explanations including pipeline origin in a user-readable format, preserving attribution semantics from backend contract.
